title: Project: sizes in a tree of folders

exercises.title: Size of every folder
exercises.task: Write Sizes: from a list of files and their sizes, list every folder with the total size of everything below it, down to a given depth, children before their parent. The spec is in the comments of the file. Run prints the output for a small thesis at depths 0, 1 and 2.
hints: Build a tree first: a folder node holds the sizes of its own files and a map from name to child folder. Split each path on /; every part but the last is a folder.
The total of a folder is its files plus the totals of its children: a post-order recursion (1.3.3) that returns the total.
Print in post-order too: the children (sorted by name) before the folder, and only folders whose depth is ≤ maxDepth. Compute the totals of deeper ones anyway.
